mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2% over three consecutive months signals a tightening cycle, which raises discount rates and reduces present value of future corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.10) in periods where FEDFUNDS > 2% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 below -2% indicates a contraction in real economic activity, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when GDPC1 YoY < -2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressure and input costs, ultimately reducing profit margins and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of UNRATE > 6.5% for two months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO below -1% for three consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue prospects and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO < -1% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in both GDPC1 and HOUST above their 12-month moving averages signals strengthening housing and overall demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST exceed their 12-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in FEDFUNDS below 0.5% while CPIAUCSL rises above 2% YoY for three months signals a failed monetary easing, which erodes real yields and boosts equities, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2% for 3 months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive under the described monetary regime.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent fall in PAYEMS below its 12-month moving average for four consecutive months signals weakening employment, which reduces consumer spending and corporate revenues, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when PAYEMS is persistently below its 12-month moving average for four months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in RSAFS above its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months signals rising household savings, which often coincides with precautionary behavior and reduced consumption, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS is above its 12-month moving average for six months.
